Changeling.description: Changelings are fey shapeshifters who can alter their appearance at will, with innate social instincts and a connection to the fey realm.

Kalashtar.description: Kalashtar are aberration-touched beings with dual minds, telepathy, psychic resilience, and a connection to the plane of dreams.

Khoravar.description: Khoravar are half-elves with fey ancestry, darkvision, versatile magical gifts, and adaptable skill aptitude.

Shifter.description: Shifters are humanoids with bestial instincts who can temporarily shift into a more feral form, gaining temporary hit points and special abilities.

Warforged.description: Warforged are living constructs with integrated protection, poison resistance, and tireless endurance. They don't need to sleep or eat.
